items.statement: TimeSync should begin as a system-level framing layer rather than an immediate protocol replacement effort.
support: Risk-management guidance for PNT users emphasizes identify/detect/respond/recover
items.expiry_trigger: Counterevidence that one protocol-centered framing cleanly captures the problem with less loss

items.statement: Uncertainty is a load-bearing output, not an optional metadata field.
support: Delay asymmetry and bounded error concerns in NTP/NTS/chrony
TrueTime interval model as a strong design signal
items.scope: all candidate identities considered so far
items.expiry_trigger: Evidence that downstream consumers can be served safely and legibly without explicit uncertainty

items.statement: Time semantics themselves may need an explicit boundary because UTC governance is evolving toward 2035.
support: CGPM 2022 resolution on continuity / UT1-UTC changes by or before 2035
items.expiry_trigger: Decision to scope TimeSync strictly below civil-time semantic governance
